title: dysoxylum dempoense

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote digestive health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of fever. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
